notes.title: Announcing Terra Ventura Update and a New Game - Subzero Tides
notes.content:
Hello, hope everyone is doing well. I have some news to share after a long hiatus. 

[h2]Terra Ventura Update
[/h2]

I'm pleased to announce a minor update for Terra Ventura, designed to enhance your gaming experience. This update addresses minor bugs and fine-tunes the user experience. The game is now feature complete, and I'm committed to providing long-term support to address any major new bugs that may surface.

[h2]New Project: Subzero Tides[/h2]

But that's not all! I'm thrilled to announce new project, Subzero Tides. Set on the icy moon of Europa, this sci-fi colony builder offers an immersive experience. Build a self-sustaining colony, harness geothermal vents for power, and manage your colonists in a captivating blend of exploration, survival, and strategic decision-making.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544930/?utm_campaign=steam_announcement

[previewyoutube=Xe7rz0W0D3I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Development Status[/h2]

Current status of the development is a playable vertical slice with major systems implemented and technical feasibility checked. Major systems included are building a colony, colonists having independent AI, core game architecture, UI, users having options to overwrite the actions of the colonists, etc. Content wise the game is at the end of pre-production. 

Subzero Tides is a single player PC game and all efforts are going towards making a polished single player experience for PC. All other game modes, platforms or modding support might happen at a later point but are not going to be considered until the base game is at its best.

[h2]Project premise[/h2]

For a sneak peek into the game's direction, check out the basic premise of Subzero Tides:  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40737137/c20ac2543eebf3ec233a9e5096626ec3d2ccddd8.png[/img]

Thank you for your support. I invite you keep track of the new project Subzero Tides by wishlisting, and now is the perfect time to enjoy Terra Ventura with a 75% discount!

notes.title: March 2022 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40737137/0317a337339a6f78d979ee4b4f28e8c4828a9ef2.png[/img]
Hello all,

I am happy to let you know that the Terra Ventura game was just updated !

Changes to the initial Early Access build are:

[list]
[*] Normal difficulty now has ammo and alchemy potion drops placed around the maps. 
[*] There are no ammo or alchemy potion drops on hard difficulty. 
[*] Rework of the difficulty system - normal difficulty is now easier, most notably in the earlier levels. 
[*] Hard difficulty was made harder with enemies dealing more damage. 
[*] New achievements available.
[*] There are now GUI indicators of the actions - picking up ammo, alchemy potions and runes.  
[*] Enemies using shockwave now have increased cool down period so it is possible to deal damage in between attacks. 
[*] Late game map was redesigned as per player feedback.
[*] Added warnings before player enters areas dealing toxic attack damage. 
[*] Fixed a bug rendering one of the late game underground levels improperly. 
[*] Fixed a bug with spawning of the collectibles and accompanying achievement. 
[*] Crafting tab was renamed to the materials tab to more accurately reflect its purpose. 
[*] Fixed various bugs with rendering of the graphics. 
[*] Fixed minor bugs. 
[/list]

Please note that the changes made the previous save games incompatible. If anyone wants to play through the save game first I prepared the branch with previous version of the game, where you will be able to finish the save game. All you have to do is select game properties and opt into initial branch under betas. 

Updates will be rolling out on the schedule so stay tuned for the upcoming game updates and have fun playing the game ! 

Regards

notes.title: December 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hello all, 

Terra Ventura game development is well on the track for the Early Access release within the next two months. Recent testing of the game highlighted some areas I would like to polish before the Early Access release, and even though game is already in a playable state, I want to clear the issues I am aware of before releasing it to the public. 

Some of the features that were added recently are:

[list]
[*] class unique skill tree branches
[*] mini-map
[*] new maps
[*] unique soundtrack
[*] auto-saves
[*] selling items
[*] GUI improvements
[*] achievements
[*] leader-boards
[/list]
Stay tuned for the announcement of the Early Access release date which will come a few weeks before the date. 

Regards

notes.title: September 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hello all, 

I am happy to announce that Terra Ventura will be a part of the Steam Next festival where you will be able to play the demo from 1st October to 7th of October 2021 ! 

Additionally, there has been a significant progress towards Early access release scheduled for later this year. During the summer playtesting many areas of the game were improved, there are already fist steps towards having balanced experience and there are a lot of minor improvements to the UI and general bug-fixing. 

Stay tuned for the next update.

Regards

notes.title: July 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hello all, 

I am happy to announce that there has been a significant progress towards the first closed beta scheduled for the next month. There are still some bugs and areas to polish, so first to play should already get a product where most obvious issues are worked through. 

Some of the areas that have been improved lately are:
- There are now 30+ enemies within the game with different abilities and strengths. 
- UI improvements
- Balancing of the XP system
- Design of the first set of maps
- Updates to the combat system
- Hired artist created new box art
- Expanded bestiary

Some of the items from to-do list are:
- enemies dealing damage to other enemies
- directional blocking for the shield
- achievements
- maps polish
- various fixes

Stay tuned for the next update.

Regards
